resources.string: On: use the system USB network. Off: use the existing connection method. Applies at the next connection. If connection fails, switch manually; neither method falls back automatically.
Choose one of four methods. VPN tries automatic authorization first. Applies at the next connection. If it fails, switch manually; no method falls back automatically.
Automatic VPN authorization failed. Retry, or authorize through the system. The connection method will stay VPN.
